language_tracks.description: Per-target-language sub-state. Keys are ISO 639-1 codes.

skip_translation.description: True when this track's language IS the source language: it skips the TRANSLATION stage (verbatim source captions are produced instead of a pointless source->source translation).

auto_translate.description: True when this track is AI-auto-translated with deterministic QA only (no human-filled worksheet, no per-language translation_qa human gate). Set for every translatable target that is NOT the source language and NOT English; source+en keep the human worksheet + gate. Orthogonal to skip_translation (the source track is never auto-translated).

active_artifacts.description: Map of artifact-key -> active sha256. Key is 'type' for shared artifacts and 'type@lang' for per-language artifacts.
